# CORE-DAT-02

**Are residency, retention and lineage stated for personal and restricted data?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | DAT: Data |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `data.personal`, `data.classification`, `data.residency`, `data.retention`, `data.lineage` |

## Rule

Every data set with personal true or classification confidential or restricted has residency, retention and lineage.

## Sources

- LINDDUN privacy threat modelling (`linddun`)
- Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, Annex IV, technical documentation (`eu-aiact-annex4`)
